segments.text: Monkey wants to build an automated banana factory, which new anthropic model does monkey
hire.
There are two new apes in the jungle.
Option 1.
Higher Gorilla Fable 5 Fable 5 is a giant mythos gorilla built from multi-day autonomous
research, deep reasoning, long horizon tasks, monkey hands Fable 5 broken banana code.
Fable 5 stares at the screen.
Thing for a five day straight, no sleep, no banana break, rebuilds the entire factory
from scratch.
Fable 5 gets top scores on SWE Bench, a number one on the AI index, gorilla dominates
every test.
Monkey happy, monkey hires Fable 5, then monkey gets the bill, input costs 10 bananas per
million words, output costs 50 bananas per million words.
Monkey reads the invoice three times, your card was declined, monkey wallet empty, pesky
gorilla pricing, monkey poor, monkey sad, option 2, higher chip engineer opus 5, opus
5 is the flagship workhorse built for daily software engineering, monkey hands, opus 5
1 million scrolls, opus 5 reads everything in one second, one million token context
window, fixes code, builds tools, audit security, finished before lunchtime.
On intelligence tests, opus 5 ties Pable 5, same brain, same gorilla level reasoning,
but opus 5 wears a yellow hard hat, shows up to work every single day.
Best of all, opus 5 costs half, 5 bananas input per million words, 25 bananas output per
million words, half price, same intelligence, monkey wallet happy, monkey rich, but wait,
which model is actually better.
Monkey runs a jungle stress test, gives both models the exact same broken app, Able 5 disappears
for 3 days, returns with a complex masterpiece, opus 5 fixes the bug in 2 hours, both apps
work perfectly, so what is the secret difference?
Fable 5 thinks deeper and takes longer, opus 5 thinks fast and ships code faster.
Same destination, different jungle paths, option 3, secret jungle discounts, both models
have adaptive thinking, monkey turns the brain knob up or down, low effort for quick, simple
answers, max effort for deep gorilla reasoning, monkey controls how hard they think, both
models use pre-peeled banana caching, show the same scroll blueprint twice, monkey bank
gives 90% discount, opus 5 cash input costs half a banana, fable 5 cash input costs
swine banana, jungle startup runs super cheap with caching, so which model should monkey
pick?
Multiday autonomous research jobs, complex multi-step engineering projects, higher gorilla
fable 5, worth every single banana, daily coding, coal pilots and chat assistance, fast
reliable software engineering, higher chimp engineer opus 5, 95% for set performance
at half price, smart monkey uses both, fable 5 for big gorilla tasks, opus 5 for daily
engineering, two monkeys, one jungle, maximum bananas, save your bananas, subscribe for
more monkey breakdowns.
